provider.drive.name: Google Drive
provider.onedrive.name: Microsoft OneDrive
menu.welcome:
Welcome to CloudDrives!
This tool mounts OneDrive and Google Drive as drives in Windows.
First, let's connect an account. You sign in securely in your browser and
enter your password only on Microsoft's or Google's own page.
menu.engineStopped: Background service stopped (starts automatically when connecting)
status.noDrives: No drives set up yet. Press [3] to add an account.
disconnect.pendingExplain:
Files are still being uploaded to the cloud. If you disconnect now,
the upload resumes automatically the next time you connect.
disconnect.wait: Wait until everything is uploaded (Esc stops waiting)
setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: CloudDrives now checks the required components and sets them up if needed.
setup.winfsp.explain:
Drive letters require the WinFsp driver.
Installing it needs administrator rights once: Windows will ask for your
confirmation (User Account Control). Please confirm with "Yes".
setup.winfsp.declined: Without WinFsp no drives can be mounted. You can run the setup again at any time.
setup.winfsp.installing: Installing WinFsp - please confirm the Windows prompt ...
setup.secure.ok: Encrypted storage is set up (key stored in the Windows Credential Manager).
wizard.add.title: Add account
wizard.add.providerQuestion: Which account do you want to connect?
wizard.add.provider.onedrive: OneDrive (personal Microsoft account, including Microsoft 365 Family)
wizard.add.provider.googlePersonal: Google Drive (personal Google account, e.g. Google One)
wizard.add.labelPrompt: Name for this account (shown in Explorer)
wizard.add.clientQuestion: Which Google client ID should be used?
wizard.add.client.default: rclone default - ready immediately (sometimes throttled under heavy use)
wizard.add.client.own: Own client ID - faster and more reliable (one-time setup)
wizard.add.loginExplain:
Your browser opens in a moment. Sign in there and allow access.
You enter your password only on the provider's page - CloudDrives never sees it.
wizard.add.workspaceHint:
Note for Workspace admins: if the Admin console blocks access, mark the app as trusted under
Security > API controls.
wizard.add.browserOpening: Opening the browser. If it does not open, visit this address:
wizard.add.browserFailed: The browser could not be opened automatically - please copy the address above.
wizard.add.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser ... (Esc = cancel)
wizard.add.letterInvalid: {0} is not free. Please choose one of the free letters.
wizard.remove.title: Remove account
wizard.remove.explain:
The account is disconnected and its sign-in is deleted from this PC.
Your files in the cloud are not changed.
wizard.remove.revokeHint: Tip: at {0} you can also revoke the access at the provider.
help.text:
Usage: CloudDrives.bat [command] [options]

  (no command)               open the menu
  connect | verbinden        connect drives (all, or e.g. "connect K")
  disconnect | trennen       disconnect drives (--force: despite running uploads)
  status                     show status (--json for scripts)
  add-account                add an account
  remove-account             remove an account
  setup | einrichten         check or install rclone and WinFsp
  version                    show the program version
  help | hilfe               this help

Options:
  --silent                   no output (for autostart)

Logs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\CloudDrives\logs
error.CD-0001.title: Already connected
error.CD-0002.title: Not connected
error.CD-1001.title: rclone is missing
error.CD-1001.fix: Run the setup (CloudDrives.bat setup) - rclone is downloaded automatically.
error.CD-1002.title: WinFsp is not installed
error.CD-1002.fix: Run the setup (CloudDrives.bat setup) and confirm the Windows prompt.
error.CD-1003.title: rclone is too old
error.CD-1003.fix: Run the setup to install the matching rclone version.
error.CD-1004.title: Download failed
error.CD-1004.fix: Check the internet connection (or proxy/firewall) and try again.
error.CD-1005.title: PowerShell is too old
error.CD-1005.fix: CloudDrives needs Windows PowerShell 5.1 (Windows 10/11) or PowerShell 7.
error.CD-1006.title: Checksum or signature mismatch
error.CD-1006.fix: The downloaded file was discarded for security reasons. Please try again later.
error.CD-1007.title: Administrator confirmation cancelled
error.CD-1007.fix: Run the setup again and confirm the Windows prompt with "Yes".
error.CD-2001.title: Settings are invalid
error.CD-2001.fix: settings.json is damaged. A backup is stored as settings.json.bak in the same folder.
error.CD-2002.title: Stored sign-in data cannot be decrypted
error.CD-2002.fix: The key does not match the configuration. Remove and reconnect the accounts if needed.
error.CD-2003.title: The key for the sign-in data is missing
error.CD-2003.fix: The key in the Windows Credential Manager was deleted. Accounts have to be reconnected.
error.CD-2004.title: Master password required
error.CD-2004.fix: Open CloudDrives and enter your master password.
error.CD-2005.title: Settings were written by a newer version
error.CD-2005.fix: Update CloudDrives to the latest version.
error.CD-2006.title: Account or drive not found
error.CD-2006.fix: Check the name or drive letter (CloudDrives.bat status).
error.CD-3001.title: Sign-in expired or revoked
error.CD-3001.fix: Remove the account and add it again to sign in once more.
error.CD-3002.title: The provider is throttling requests (rate limit)
error.CD-3002.fix: Wait a moment. For Google, an own client ID helps permanently (see docs/GOOGLE-OAUTH.md).
error.CD-3003.title: Access blocked by an administrator policy
error.CD-3003.fix: In the Google Admin console, mark the app as trusted under Security > API controls.
error.CD-3004.title: Sign-in cancelled
error.CD-3004.fix: Start "Add account" again and allow access in the browser.
error.CD-3005.title: Sign-in timed out
error.CD-3005.fix: The sign-in in the browser was not completed in time. Please try again.
error.CD-3006.title: Cloud storage is full
error.CD-3006.fix: Free up space or upgrade your storage plan at the provider.
error.CD-3007.title: Sign-in port 53682 is in use
error.CD-3007.fix: Another program (often a second rclone) uses the port. Close it and try again.
error.CD-3008.title: Sign-in failed
error.CD-3008.fix: Check the internet connection and try signing in again.
error.CD-4001.title: Drive letter is in use
error.CD-4001.fix: Choose a different letter (e.g. a NAS or USB drive already uses it).
error.CD-4002.title: Drive did not become ready in time
error.CD-4002.fix: Please connect again. If that does not help, check the log for details.
error.CD-4003.title: Mounting failed
error.CD-4003.fix: Details are in the log. Connecting again often helps.
error.CD-4004.title: Disconnecting failed
error.CD-4004.fix: Close programs that still have files open on the drive and try again.
error.CD-4005.title: No free drive letter
error.CD-4005.fix: Free up a drive letter (e.g. disconnect a network drive).
error.CD-4006.title: Uploads are still pending
error.CD-4006.fix: Wait until all files are uploaded, or disconnect with --force (uploads resume later).
error.CD-5001.title: No internet connection
error.CD-5001.fix: Check the connection. Drives are connected as soon as the internet is reachable.
error.CD-5002.title: The background service cannot get a network port
error.CD-5002.fix: Please try again. If the error persists, a firewall may block local connections.
error.CD-5003.title: Background service not reachable
error.CD-5003.fix: Connect the drives again - the service is restarted automatically.
error.CD-5004.title: Background service could not start
error.CD-5004.fix: Details are in the log (menu item "Open logs").
error.CD-6001.title: Wrong vault password or damaged data
error.CD-6001.fix: Check the vault password (see recovery kit). The vault is not mounted for your protection.
error.CD-6002.title: Vault check file is missing
error.CD-6002.fix: The folder is not a CloudDrives vault or was modified.
error.CD-7001.title: Not enough space for the cache
error.CD-7001.fix: Free up space on the cache drive or reduce the cache size in the settings.
error.CD-7002.title: Errors in the local cache
error.CD-7002.fix: Disconnect and reconnect the drives. Details are in the log.
error.CD-9000.title: Unknown error
error.CD-9000.fix: Details are in the log (menu item "Open logs").
error.CD-9001.title: Unexpected internal error
error.CD-9001.fix: Please check the log and report the error.
error.CD-9002.title: CloudDrives is busy
error.CD-9002.fix: Another CloudDrives action is still running. Please wait a moment and try again.
